text:
emma-support: Customer reports paid invoice INV-7729 is missing the PO number. Portal shows PO value but the issued PDF/record does not. They need a corrected invoice for their Q4 audit.

sara-cs: Got the escalation from live chat, customer is urgent — needs a corrected invoice or clear steps for a credit/rebill.

jordan-billing: Can you paste the exact PO string from the portal + invoice/payment ids?

emma-support: Portal PO field (exact): PO#A-123/45
invoice id: INV-7729
payment id: PAY-9912
(Screenshot link provided in ticket)

katie-payments: Confirming payment settled. We can't edit a paid invoice via the UI. Typical path is: create a credit note for the paid invoice, then reissue a corrected invoice with the PO and either reapply payment or request a refund + reapply. Need finance approval for refund.

mike-ingest: tagging eng-infra — quick note: ingestion pipeline appears to strip everything after a '#' when converting incoming payloads. Repro steps below.

emma-support: Repro payload we used to create the invoice via ingestion API:
```
POST /v1/invoices
{
  "invoice_id":"INV-7729",
  "customer_id":"C-334",
  "po":"PO#A-123/45",
  "items":[{"desc":"monthly","amount":1000}],
  "paid": true
}
```

mike-ingest: Ingest logs show truncation: 
```
2024-11-02T14:02:10Z INFO  ingest received po="PO#A-123/45"
2024-11-02T14:02:10Z WARN  parser truncating field 'po' at delimiter '#'
2024-11-02T14:02:10Z INFO  stored po="PO"
```

mike-ingest: Reproduced locally. Root cause: legacy CSV-to-JSON parsing routine treats '#' as comment start and '/' as field delimiter in one of the ingestion stages. PR #4821 fixes the parser to respect quoted strings and not treat '#' specially. I will push the PR today; deploy scheduled for tomorrow.

jordan-billing: For support ops (manual path) — documented steps so we don't lose this:
1) Create full-credit note for INV-7729 (so original invoice is offset).
2) Refund or reassign payment: finance decides whether to refund PAY-9912 or reapply it to the new invoice.
3) Create corrected invoice INV-7729-R1 with identical line items and correct PO field (enter via Billing UI which bypasses ingestion).
4) If customer requests immediate corrected PDF for audit, mark the new invoice as paid by applying payment or add a cover note that payment will be reapplied.
5) Add internal note linking to FIN-1145 for refund/reapply approval.

Sample support reply to customer: "We found a parsing bug that removed special characters from your PO. We can either issue a corrected invoice immediately via a manual rebill (requires creating a credit and reissuing the invoice) or wait ~48 hours for an automatic backfill after our deploy. Which would you prefer?"

katie-payments: I can handle the refund/reapply once finance signs off. Tagging @finance for approval.

mike-ingest: Short-term mitigation: we can run a backfill using ingestion logs to patch stored PO for affected invoices. Longer-term: PR fixes parser and adds unit tests for special chars. Estimated timeline: PR merged today, deploy tomorrow, backfill job in 24–48 hours.

emma-support: I'm going to perform the manual credit+rebill now as the customer needs a PDF for audit. Will follow the steps above and attach the new invoice. ETA ~1 hour for manual rebill, and I'll request finance approval for refund/reapply.

rebill-bot: created task RB-2024 assigned to emma-support (internal-only).

emma-support: Thanks all — updating the ticket and informing the customer: providing manual corrected invoice now, automated fix ETA 48 hours. :white_check_mark:
